caption: Helmuth von Moltke the Younger (1848–1916), Chief of the General Staff 1906–1914, who inherited Schlieffen's plan and altered it. Photographed in 1906 on taking office. Colorized (AI-assisted) from a public-domain photograph.
credit: Original photograph: E. Bieber studio, 1906, published in Die Woche; public domain (via Wikimedia Commons). Colorization: Sandtable, AI-assisted, 2026.
notes: Provided by Dave on 2026-08-22. Pairs with the Schlieffen portrait (same studio, same year) — ideal for a side-by-side 'the author and the heir' moment in the prologue.
